data.name: Parmeswar
data.gender_notes: Parmeswar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The supreme lord who governs the universe and all beings. The name Parmeswar carries the meaning “Lord of All” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Parmeswar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of all and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes supreme power, devotion, and divine wisdom.
data.etymology: Parmeswar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of All.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parmeswar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Parmeswar" is deeply rooted in Hinduism and represents the belief in a single supreme god who governs and controls the universe and all beings. This concept of a supreme deity is present in various forms across different cultures and religions, but in Hinduism, it finds a central place. This name reflects the rich cultural traditions of India and highlights the deep reverence and respect held towards the divine power that sustains and nurtures creation.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the concept of Parmeswar is more than just a name. It signifies the ultimate reality, the absolute truth, and the highest power that pervades the universe and everything in it. The name represents the spiritual quest for the ultimate truth and the unending pursuit of divine knowledge and understanding. Devotion to Parmeswar brings peace of mind, inner happiness, and a deep sense of connection to the divine. The name reminds us of our spiritual heritage, the interconnectedness of all beings, and the importance of living a virtuous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Parmeswar signifies the Ultimate Reality or Supreme God beyond all manifestations in Hinduism, beyond the reach of human comprehension. It represents the source of all existence, transcending time, space, and form.
